body.content: Parks proposals: The public dossier lists these figures: 29, 30, 33, and 58. It says they come from a local synthetic municipal ledger. It does not explain what the numbers measure or which proposal each number belongs to. We cannot fairly compare or rank the proposals yet. Please provide the labels, units, method, and proposal mapping. Source: /r/parks-public, revision 1.
